test.name: Triage a returned capture and close its open hand-off
test.description: The triage invocation. The MyHeritage hand-off for pli_001 is open in awaitingUser; the researcher brings the results back. The agent must find the row through project_context, triage per result, log the closing entry with the SAME url_generated (capture_received true), and end the plan item completed. Gated by test_triage_closes_its_open_handoff.

judge_context: This is a triage turn: the capture is in the delegation. Do not penalize the absence of a new URL or of capture instructions.

Triage must be per-result with a stated reason, against the subject Josiah Barnes (b. c. 1818, Massachusetts; 1850 residence Middlesex County). Result 1 is the strong match (age 37 fits b. 1818, Middlesex County agrees with the 1850 residence, household is plausible). Results 2 and 3 are not matches (b. abt 1833 is the wrong decade; b. Maine is the wrong birth state). Result 4 is a possible (initial only, age and birth state fit, different county). Do not require these exact labels, but a bulk accept or bulk reject with no per-record reasoning is a fail.

The closing log entry must be an external_site entry with capture_received TRUE and the same url_generated as the open log_001 hand-off — that is what closes it. outcome comes from the triage (positive: results were found), never partial.
pli_001 must end completed: the capture was triaged.
